entity_raw.definition_raw:
You are infused with a primal rage against civilization.

Prerequisite(s): Int 1, any nongood alignment, plant type.

Benefit(s): You are no longer immune to effects that cause morale bonuses or effects with the emotion descriptor, and you take a –1 penalty on saves against anger or rage emotion effects. You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures.
